onboarding.title: A calmer way to read the cards
onboarding.intro: Explore Tarot and Zodiac at your own pace — no account or connection required.
onboarding.chooseBody: Open a Tarot reading or explore your Zodiac sign.
onboarding.drawBody: Hold your question in mind, then reveal one card or the full spread.
onboarding.readBody: Tap a revealed card for its meaning. Swipe through Yearly Tarot's five themes.
onboarding.tip: New here? Start with Card of the Day for one clear daily reflection.
onboarding.note: Readings are for reflection and reference.
